post.summary: Store an upload and record the resource
post.description: The gateway's `POST /resources`, forwarded untouched, with the principal the gateway verified. The Archivist stores the bytes at `storageUri`, outside git, and records the resource — as a clone of the token's source when the upload carries `cloneToken` — attributed to `Semiont-Principal`. It answers once the resource is recorded.

parameters.name: Semiont-Principal
parameters.description: The DID of the caller the gateway verified. The record attributes the resource to it. Believed because only a service account can call this route.

parameters.name: Semiont-Roles
parameters.description: That caller's roles, comma-separated; absent when it has none. A worker's `semiont-worker` is what obliges its upload to cite a job.

400.description: `Semiont-Principal` is missing; the body is not multipart/form-data, or not a ResourceUpload; the base media type is not supported; or `entityTypes` or `generator` is not what it must be. The message names what is wrong.

500.description: The bytes could not be stored, or the record refused the resource; the message says why.
